items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I worked on an album for a guy named Elliot Smith

ctx.x: I worked with Richard Marks on a couple of albums, who is a great pop star. I worked on an album for a guy named Elliot Smith that Billboard magazine named the number two album of the year last year, it was a really great alternative songwriter. So you never know. I mean I’ve worked with Mickey Gilley in country music and I’ve kind of worked with a wide variety, there’s some Japanese, I do a lot of work for Japanese superstars and they’ve got a whole sound. And I love that because this one guy I work with…
Do you usually get the assignment musically after the fact, after they’ve laid down most of the tune and then, okay, now what can you do with this?
